detected_by: Railway deployment history correlated with CUSTOMER_PROOF_STATUS.md
correlation: The immutable repository manifest still identifies the same sealed 0.6.76 artifact and runtime SHA.
The current Railway deployment is a redeploy and is healthy, with fixture/demo-only and production-approved=false runtime messages.
The customer-proof status document still calls the earlier now-removed deployment the exact live deployment.
Therefore runtime health is not in dispute, but the current live deployment identity is no longer bound by the existing written proof record.
root_cause: A later Railway redeploy changed the live deployment identifier after the original exact-deployment proof document was written. Mutable platform deployment identity and immutable candidate identity were not separated strongly enough in the proof record.
containment: Do not claim the removed deployment ID is the current live deployment.
Continue to describe the host as staging/fixture-only and production-unapproved.
Preserve the immutable candidate hash as the root release identity, but require fresh platform provenance for each redeploy before calling that deployment exact-proven.
Do not redeploy merely to repair documentation.

detection_rules.when: A proof document names a concrete cloud deployment as current or exact.
require: The named deployment ID is the platform's current successful deployment for the fixed service/environment.
The deployment is independently tied to the frozen runtime SHA or to a verified redeploy of the exact immutable image/snapshot.
Outside-in health and authentication-boundary evidence is newer than or equal to the deployment creation time.
detection_rules.on_mismatch: downgrade claim from exact-current-deployment proof to healthy-host evidence until provenance is re-bound

safe_runbook: Read the fixed Railway project, environment and service IDs from the approved proof record.
Resolve the latest successful deployment and its reason without changing Railway state.
If the deployment ID differs, obtain build/snapshot provenance and re-run outside-in health, auth, tenant and integrity proof.
Update proof documentation only after the current deployment is bound to the immutable candidate identity.
Never infer production approval from Railway environment naming or SUCCESS status.
learning: Candidate identity and cloud deployment identity are separate. A safe redeploy can preserve the candidate while invalidating an old claim that a specific deployment ID is the current exact proof.
